title: A failed start-notification LISTEN or NOTIFY is silent, so the under-1-second gap quietly becomes the 5 s refresh
notes: listenOnce returns on a failed connect or LISTEN without logging; sessions.go discards the pg_notify error. Behind a transaction-mode pooler notifications never arrive. Log it once, and list the session-mode connection for the stream role in ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/running.md. Promoted to JS-056.
